senses.en: Near the beginning of a period or before the usual time
Before the expected time or near the beginning

ex.en: We caught an early train and arrived before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我們趕上了一班早車，在早餐前就到了。

ex.en: Early investment in childhood education can reduce inequality and improve employment prospects later in life.
ex.zh: 及早投資幼兒教育可以減少不平等，並改善孩子成年後的就業前景。

tip: early兼作形容詞和副詞，不加-ly。

senses.en: Used before plural nouns for nearby people or things.
Nearby people or things, or ones just mentioned.

ex.en: These strawberries smell lovely, so let's buy a basket.
ex.zh: 這些草莓聞起來很香，我們買一籃吧。

ex.en: These findings suggest that regular outdoor activities can improve children's concentration and emotional health.
ex.zh: 這些研究結果表明，經常參加戶外活動可以改善兒童的注意力和情緒健康。

col: in these circumstances｜在這些情況下
tip: these是this的複數，後接複數名詞。

senses.en: liked more than any other of the same kind
a person or thing someone likes best
the competitor considered most likely to win

ex.en: This little bakery sells my favourite kind of bread.
ex.zh: 這家小麪包店賣我最喜歡的那種麪包。

ex.en: Public libraries allow readers to discover new authors as well as revisit their favourite books without additional cost.
ex.zh: 公共圖書館讓讀者無需額外花費，既能發現新作家，也能重讀自己最喜愛的書。

col: a firm favourite｜一直備受喜愛的人或物
the favourite to win｜奪冠熱門
tip: 英式拼寫favourite，美式favorite；一般不用most修飾。

senses.en: A person or animal that has finished growing.
Fully grown, or relating to grown people.

ex.en: Children must visit the swimming pool with an adult.
ex.zh: 兒童必須由成年人陪同前往游泳池。

ex.en: Adult education programmes help people gain new qualifications and adapt to changes in the labour market.
ex.zh: 成人教育項目幫助人們獲得新的資格，並適應勞動力市場的變化。

tip: 既可作可數名詞，也可作形容詞，如adult education。

senses.en: a device that shows the time
to measure or record the time or speed of something

ex.en: The kitchen clock stopped while we were making lunch.
ex.zh: 我們做午飯時，廚房的時鐘停了。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to work when they are most productive, rather than watching the clock.
ex.zh: 彈性工作安排讓員工在效率最高時工作，而不是盯着時鐘等下班。

col: watch the clock｜盯着時間等下班
tip: clock通常指鍾；戴在手腕上的表叫watch。

senses.en: On or towards a lower floor of a building
Located on a lower floor of a building

ex.en: I went downstairs when I smelled fresh bread.
ex.zh: 聞到新鮮麪包的香味後，我下了樓。

ex.en: Providing a downstairs bedroom can help older residents remain independent in their own homes.
ex.zh: 在樓下設置臥室可以幫助老年住戶在自己家中保持獨立生活。

tip: 作副詞時直接說go downstairs，不加to。

senses.en: Facts or details about someone or something

ex.en: The receptionist gave us useful information about local buses.
ex.zh: 接待員向我們提供了有關當地公交車的實用信息。

ex.en: Access to reliable information enables patients to make better decisions about their treatment and long-term health.
ex.zh: 獲取可靠信息能幫助患者就治療和長期健康作出更好的決定。

col: access to information｜信息獲取渠道
a piece of information｜一條信息
tip: 不可數：說some information，不說an information。

senses.en: A dark classroom board used for writing or drawing with chalk.

ex.en: Our teacher drew a huge circle on the blackboard.
ex.zh: 老師在黑板上畫了一個大圓圈。

ex.en: Although digital screens offer interactive features, a traditional blackboard remains an affordable teaching tool for many schools.
ex.zh: 儘管電子屏幕具有互動功能，傳統黑板仍是許多學校負擔得起的教學工具。

col: write on the blackboard｜在黑板上書寫
tip: 在黑板上用on the blackboard；配合粉筆使用。

senses.en: A social gathering where people celebrate or enjoy themselves.
An organised group seeking political power through shared policies.
A person or group involved in an agreement or dispute.

ex.en: We held a small party in the garden yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我們在花園裏辦了一場小聚會。

ex.en: Each political party should explain how its education policies will benefit students from disadvantaged backgrounds.
ex.zh: 每個政黨都應說明其教育政策將如何惠及弱勢背景的學生。

tip: 合同中的party指當事方，不是聚會或政黨。

senses.en: An occasion when you eat, or the food eaten then.

ex.en: Dad cooked a warm meal after our long walk.
ex.zh: 我們長途步行回來後，爸爸做了一頓熱乎乎的飯。

ex.en: Providing healthy school meals can improve children's concentration and support their physical development.
ex.zh: 提供健康的學校餐食能提高兒童的專注力，並促進他們的身體發育。

tip: meal指一頓飯；food泛指食物，通常不可數。

senses.en: a seat for one person, usually with a back
the person responsible for leading a meeting or committee
to lead a meeting and manage its discussion

ex.en: She pulled a chair closer to the window.
ex.zh: 她把一把椅子拉到離窗戶更近的地方。

ex.en: An independent expert should chair the meeting to ensure that all participants can contribute fairly.
ex.zh: 應由一位獨立專家主持會議，確保所有參與者都能公平地發表意見。

tip: chair作動詞直接接meeting，表示主持會議。

senses.en: Not at any time.
Certainly not, used to express strong refusal or intention.

ex.en: I never leave home without my water bottle.
ex.zh: 我出門從來都帶着水瓶。

ex.en: Public transport can never fully replace walking and cycling as accessible forms of daily exercise.
ex.zh: 作爲方便易行的日常運動方式，步行和騎行永遠無法被公共交通完全取代。

tip: 通常放在實義動詞前，be動詞或助動詞後。

senses.en: The central part, point, or position of something
Located between other things or between the beginning and end

ex.en: Someone left a suitcase in the middle of the hallway.
ex.zh: 有人把一個行李箱放在了走廊正中央。

ex.en: Housing costs often force essential workers to live far from the middle of the cities they serve.
ex.zh: 住房成本常常迫使提供必要服務的工作者住在遠離其服務城市中心的地方。

tip: 名詞常用the middle of；形容詞直接修飾名詞。

senses.en: slightly cold, often in a pleasant way
calm and able to think clearly under pressure
to become or make something less hot

ex.en: A cool breeze drifted through the open kitchen window.
ex.zh: 一陣涼爽的微風從敞開的廚房窗戶吹了進來。

ex.en: Planting more trees can help cool urban areas and reduce energy demand during summer.
ex.zh: 種植更多樹木有助於爲城市地區降溫，並減少夏季的能源需求。

tip: cool 比 cold 溫和；口語中還可表示“很酷的”。

senses.en: The month after August and before October.

ex.en: Our evening photography course starts in September this year.
ex.zh: 我們今年的攝影夜課九月開課。

ex.en: In many countries, the academic year begins in September, creating seasonal demand for student accommodation near universities.
ex.zh: 許多國家的學年在九月開始，使大學附近的學生住宿出現季節性需求。

tip: 月份首字母大寫；用 in September，但 next September 前不加 in。

senses.en: Not difficult and requiring little effort.
Relaxed and free from worry or pressure.

ex.en: This soup is easy to make with fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 用新鮮蔬菜做這道湯很容易。

ex.en: Providing easy access to reliable health information can help people make better decisions about their lifestyles.
ex.zh: 讓人們方便地獲取可靠的健康信息，有助於他們作出更好的生活方式選擇。

col: easy access to｜便於獲取或到達……
tip: 常用easy to do；修飾動作通常用easily。

senses.en: an object whose name is unknown or not specified
an action, event, fact, or situation
possessions or equipment, usually referred to in the plural

ex.en: Could you move that heavy thing off my chair?
ex.zh: 你能把那個沉東西從我的椅子上搬走嗎？

ex.en: One important thing governments can do is ensure that affordable housing is available near public transport.
ex.zh: 政府可以做的一件重要事情，是確保公共交通附近有可負擔的住房。

col: the right thing to do｜正確的做法
first thing in the morning｜早晨第一件事
one thing at a time｜一次一件事
tip: thing很籠統；正式寫作儘量換成具體名詞。

senses.en: the opening in your face used for eating and speaking
the opening of a cave or where a river meets the sea
to form words with your lips without making a sound

ex.en: The dentist asked me to open my mouth wider.
ex.zh: 牙醫讓我把嘴張大一點。

ex.en: Wetlands near the mouth of a river provide valuable habitats and help protect coastal communities from flooding.
ex.zh: 河口附近的溼地提供了寶貴的棲息地，也有助於保護沿海社區免遭洪災。

col: the mouth of a river｜河口
tip: 名詞末音爲/θ/；動詞末音爲/ð/。

senses.en: Spend time learning about or carefully examining a subject.
The activity of learning, or an investigation of a subject.
A room used for reading, writing, or working.

ex.en: I study English on the bus every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上在公交車上學英語。

ex.en: A recent study suggests that regular exercise can improve students' concentration during classroom activities.
ex.zh: 最近一項研究表明，經常鍛鍊能提高學生在課堂活動中的專注力。

col: a recent study｜最近的一項研究
study for an exam｜爲考試學習
tip: study強調學習過程，learn常強調學會或獲得知識。

senses.en: Any thing at all, without limits on choice
Something, used especially in questions and conditional statements

ex.en: You can choose anything from this basket of toys.
ex.zh: 你可以從這籃玩具裏隨便挑一件。

ex.en: Before introducing new policies, governments should check whether anything similar has worked successfully elsewhere.
ex.zh: 在推行新政策之前，政府應查明其他地方是否有類似的成功做法。

tip: 疑問句中常指“什麼”；陳述句中可指“任何事物”。

senses.en: someone who takes part in a sport or game
someone who plays a musical instrument
a device or program that plays recorded sound or video

ex.en: Each player shook hands before the football match began.
ex.zh: 足球比賽開始前，每位球員都握了手。

ex.en: Young players benefit from coaches who value teamwork and personal development rather than winning alone.
ex.zh: 教練若重視團隊合作和個人成長，而非一味追求勝利，年輕運動員就能從中受益。

col: team player｜善於團隊合作的人
tip: 樂器演奏者可用“樂器名＋player”，如piano player。

senses.en: the number equal to four times ten

ex.en: We waited forty minutes before the bus finally arrived.
ex.zh: 我們等了四十分鐘，公交車才終於到。

ex.en: The survey found that forty percent of local residents preferred cycling to driving for short journeys.
ex.zh: 調查發現，當地百分之四十的居民在短途出行時更願意騎車而非開車。

col: in her forties｜在她四十多歲時
tip: 拼寫是forty，不是fourty；四十多歲用in one's forties。

senses.en: A sweet food made from cocoa, often with milk and sugar.
An individual sweet made of chocolate, sometimes with a filling.

ex.en: He shared a bar of chocolate with his sister.
ex.zh: 他和妹妹分享了一塊巧克力。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly expect chocolate producers to ensure fair wages and safe working conditions throughout their supply chains.
ex.zh: 消費者越來越期望巧克力生產商確保整個供應鏈中的公平工資和安全工作條件。

col: a bar of chocolate｜一塊巧克力
a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力糖
tip: 食材巧克力不可數；單顆巧克力糖可數。

senses.en: How big or small someone or something is.
A standard measurement used for clothes and other products.
To sort by measurements or make something a particular size.

ex.en: This suitcase is just the right size for weekends.
ex.zh: 這個行李箱的大小正適合週末出行。

ex.en: Reducing class size may allow teachers to provide more individual support to students with learning difficulties.
ex.zh: 縮小班級規模或許能讓教師爲有學習困難的學生提供更多個別輔導。

tip: 問尺碼用What size，不用How much size。

senses.en: Limited in size, amount, or degree.
Young and not yet fully grown.
Not very important or serious.

ex.en: Our small kitchen has room for only two chairs.
ex.zh: 我們的小廚房只能放下兩把椅子。

ex.en: Even small improvements in home insulation can reduce energy consumption and lower household bills.
ex.zh: 即使對住宅保溫做出小幅改善，也能減少能源消耗並降低家庭開支。

tip: 數量少可說a small number of，不能說small people。

senses.en: Physical activities involving skill, effort, and often competition
To wear or display something in a noticeable way

ex.en: Swimming is the only sport my sister really enjoys.
ex.zh: 游泳是我姐姐唯一真正喜歡的運動。

ex.en: Regular participation in sport can improve physical health and help young people develop teamwork skills.
ex.zh: 經常參加體育運動能改善身體健康，並幫助年輕人培養團隊合作能力。

col: take part in sport｜參加體育運動
tip: 泛指體育時英式常用sport，美式常用sports。

senses.en: A formal test of knowledge or ability.

ex.en: I have a maths exam on Friday morning.
ex.zh: 我週五上午有一場數學考試。

ex.en: Schools should consider practical skills alongside exam results when assessing students' overall progress.
ex.zh: 學校在評估學生的整體進步時，應將實踐技能與考試成績一併考慮。

col: revise for an exam｜複習備考
tip: exam是examination的常用縮寫；參加考試用take。

senses.en: an adult female bovine, often kept for milk
to frighten someone into obeying or giving up resistance

ex.en: A brown cow stood quietly beside the farm gate.
ex.zh: 一頭棕色母牛靜靜地站在農場門旁。

ex.en: Improving the diet of dairy cows can increase milk production while supporting animal health.
ex.zh: 改善奶牛的飲食可以在促進動物健康的同時提高產奶量。

col: be cowed into silence｜被嚇得不敢出聲
tip: cow指成年母牛；cattle統稱牛，不能說a cattle。

senses.en: A round object used in games or shaped like one.
A formal social event where people dance.

ex.en: The dog chased the ball across the grass.
ex.zh: 那隻狗追着球跑過草地。

ex.en: Simple ball games can help children develop coordination while encouraging cooperation and regular physical activity.
ex.zh: 簡單的球類遊戲能幫助兒童發展協調能力，同時促進合作和日常體育鍛煉。

col: a ball of wool｜一團毛線
tip: 球類運動前通常不用冠詞，如play football。

senses.en: a meal eaten outdoors, usually with food brought from home
to eat a meal outdoors for pleasure

ex.en: We had a picnic under a shady tree.
ex.zh: 我們在一棵樹的蔭涼下野餐。

ex.en: Public parks provide affordable spaces where families can enjoy picnics and spend quality time together.
ex.zh: 公共公園提供了花費不高的空間，讓家庭享受野餐並共度美好時光。

tip: 動詞過去式爲picnicked，進行形式爲picnicking。

senses.en: to start happening or start doing something

ex.en: We begin dinner when everyone is sitting at the table.
ex.zh: 大家都在餐桌旁坐好後，我們開始喫晚飯。

ex.en: Schools should begin teaching digital safety early so that children develop responsible habits when using the internet.
ex.zh: 學校應儘早開始教授網絡安全知識，讓孩子養成負責任地使用互聯網的習慣。

tip: 過去式began，過去分詞begun；後接不定式或動名詞。

senses.en: as much or as many as needed
to the degree that is needed
an amount that meets a need

ex.en: We have enough rice to feed everyone tonight.
ex.zh: 我們的米夠今晚所有人喫。

ex.en: Many rural schools lack enough resources to provide students with a broad range of subjects.
ex.zh: 許多農村學校缺乏足夠的資源，無法爲學生開設廣泛的課程。

col: enough to eat｜足夠喫的東西
tip: 修飾名詞放前面，修飾形容詞或副詞放後面。

senses.en: A group learning together, or a lesson they attend.
A social group or category sharing particular characteristics.
To place someone or something in a particular category.

ex.en: Our class is learning how to grow vegetables.
ex.zh: 我們班正在學習如何種蔬菜。

ex.en: Smaller class sizes may allow teachers to give more individual attention to students with learning difficulties.
ex.zh: 較小的班級規模可能讓教師給予學習有困難的學生更多個別關注。

tip: in class通常指在上課；in the class指在這個班裏。

senses.en: Not many; a small number of countable things.
A small number of people or things.

ex.en: There were few customers in the shop this morning.
ex.zh: 今天上午店裏的顧客很少。

ex.en: Few rural communities have access to the specialist medical services available in major cities.
ex.zh: 很少有農村社區能獲得大城市所提供的專科醫療服務。

col: few and far between｜少之又少
tip: few表幾乎沒有，a few表有幾個；均接可數名詞複數。

senses.en: An area of land governed as an independent political unit.
Land outside towns and cities, often with farms and villages.
A popular music style rooted in rural American traditions.

ex.en: She hopes to visit another country next summer.
ex.zh: 她希望明年夏天去另一個國家旅行。

ex.en: Each country should develop energy policies that reflect its natural resources and long-term environmental goals.
ex.zh: 各國都應根據本國自然資源和長期環境目標制定能源政策。

col: live in the country｜住在鄉下
tip: 表示“鄉下”常用 the country，與國家義區分。

senses.en: to know what something means or how it works
to recognise why someone feels or behaves a certain way
to believe something is true based on available information

ex.en: I finally understand how to use this washing machine.
ex.zh: 我終於懂得怎麼用這臺洗衣機了。

ex.en: Schools should help students understand how their daily choices affect the natural environment.
ex.zh: 學校應幫助學生理解自己的日常選擇如何影響自然環境。

tip: 過去式和過去分詞均爲understood。

senses.en: Stop living.
Stop working or gradually become weaker and disappear.
A small cube with marked faces, thrown in games.

ex.en: These plants will die if we forget to water them.
ex.zh: 如果忘了澆水，這些植物就會枯死。

ex.en: Many marine animals die after swallowing plastic waste, highlighting the urgent need to reduce ocean pollution.
ex.zh: 許多海洋動物吞食塑料垃圾後死亡，這凸顯了減少海洋污染的迫切需要。

tip: die是動詞，dead是形容詞，death是名詞。

senses.en: The fourth month of the year.

ex.en: We are moving into our new flat in April.
ex.zh: 我們將在四月搬進新公寓。

ex.en: The community garden will open in April, giving local residents more opportunities to grow their own vegetables.
ex.zh: 社區菜園將於四月開放，讓當地居民有更多機會自己種菜。

tip: 月份首字母大寫；月份前用in，具體日期前用on。

senses.en: Accompanied by another person or thing.
Having or including a particular feature or thing.
Using a particular tool, material, or means.

ex.en: I cooked dinner with my sister last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚我和姐姐一起做了晚飯。

ex.en: Schools should work with local communities to provide children with safe spaces for outdoor activities.
ex.zh: 學校應與當地社區合作，爲兒童提供安全的戶外活動空間。

col: agree with someone｜同意某人的看法
with the help of｜在……的幫助下
tip: with後接名詞或代詞賓格，如with me。

senses.en: A flat, usually round dish used for serving food.
A flat piece of metal or another hard material.
To cover an object with a thin layer of metal.

ex.en: She placed a warm pancake on my plate.
ex.zh: 她在我的盤子裏放了一張熱乎乎的薄煎餅。

ex.en: Restaurants can reduce food waste by offering smaller plates and allowing customers to request extra portions.
ex.zh: 餐館可以提供較小的餐盤，並允許顧客要求加量，從而減少食物浪費。

col: a plate of rice｜一盤米飯
tip: plate通常指淺盤，bowl指較深的碗。

senses.en: with another person or other people
joined or combined with something else

ex.en: We cooked dinner together and shared stories about our day.
ex.zh: 我們一起做晚飯，分享各自一天的見聞。

ex.en: Schools and families should work together to help children develop healthy habits from an early age.
ex.zh: 學校和家庭應共同努力，幫助孩子從小養成健康習慣。

tip: together通常作副詞：一起做某事用動詞加together。

senses.en: the day after Friday and before Sunday

ex.en: We usually buy fresh vegetables at the market on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我們通常星期六去市場買新鮮蔬菜。

ex.en: Opening public libraries on Saturday allows more working parents to participate in educational activities with their children.
ex.zh: 公共圖書館在星期六開放，讓更多上班的家長能與孩子一起參加教育活動。

tip: 首字母大寫；on Saturday，但this Saturday前不用on。

senses.en: Having the colour of chocolate or dark wood.
The colour of chocolate or dark wood.
To become brown, or make food brown through cooking.

ex.en: A small brown dog was sleeping beside the door.
ex.zh: 一隻棕色的小狗正在門邊睡覺。

ex.en: During dry periods, grass often turns brown as plants conserve water and reduce their growth.
ex.zh: 在乾旱時期，植物爲了保存水分會減緩生長，草也常因此變成褐色。

tip: brown作動詞常用於烹飪，指把食物煎或烤至褐色。

senses.en: to use money to pay for something
to use time doing something or being somewhere

ex.en: We spent all our money on fresh fruit.
ex.zh: 我們把錢全花在了新鮮水果上。

ex.en: Governments should spend more on preventive healthcare to reduce the future costs of treating chronic diseases.
ex.zh: 政府應增加預防保健方面的支出，以減少未來治療慢性病的費用。

tip: 用spend時間doing或spend錢on；過去式spent。

senses.en: The season between summer and winter

ex.en: We collect fallen leaves in the park every autumn.
ex.zh: 我們每年秋天都在公園裏收集落葉。

ex.en: Warmer autumn temperatures may delay leaf fall and affect the seasonal behaviour of local wildlife.
ex.zh: 秋季氣溫升高可能推遲落葉，並影響當地野生動物的季節性行爲。

tip: 字母n不發音；美式英語常用fall表示秋天。

senses.en: Make something easier or better for someone.
Support that makes a difficulty or task easier.

ex.en: Could you help me carry these bags upstairs?
ex.zh: 你能幫我把這些袋子提上樓嗎？

ex.en: Affordable public transport can help residents access jobs and reduce their dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 價格實惠的公共交通可以幫助居民獲得就業機會，並減少他們對汽車的依賴。

col: help someone with something｜幫助某人做某事
tip: help後接動詞原形或to不定式均可。

senses.en: extending far upwards or positioned far above the ground
greater than usual in amount, degree, or quality
at or to a position far above the ground

ex.en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
ex.zh: 架子太高了，我夠不着。

ex.en: High housing costs can prevent young adults from living independently, particularly in major urban centres.
ex.zh: 高昂的住房成本可能使年輕人無法獨立居住，在大城市中心尤其如此。

tip: high常指位置或程度；人的身高用tall。

senses.en: A liquid food made by cooking ingredients in water or stock.

ex.en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
ex.zh: 她雙手捧着一碗湯取暖。

ex.en: Community kitchens can provide affordable vegetable soup to help residents access nutritious meals during difficult economic periods.
ex.zh: 社區廚房可以提供價格實惠的蔬菜湯，幫助居民在經濟困難時期獲得有營養的餐食。

tip: 通常不可數；點餐時two soups可指兩份湯。

senses.en: to decide which person or thing you want
to decide to do something rather than something else

ex.en: You can choose a seat beside the window.
ex.zh: 你可以選一個靠窗的座位。

ex.en: Many students choose to study abroad because they want to experience different cultures and teaching methods.
ex.zh: 許多學生選擇出國留學，因爲他們想體驗不同的文化和教學方法。

col: choose to do something｜選擇做某事
tip: 過去式chose，過去分詞chosen；後接to do。

senses.en: a recorded story or sequence of moving images for watching

ex.en: We watched a funny movie after dinner last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚晚飯後，我們看了一部有趣的電影。

ex.en: Movies can introduce audiences to unfamiliar cultures, although they sometimes reinforce stereotypes rather than challenge them.
ex.zh: 電影可以向觀衆介紹陌生文化，不過有時也會強化刻板印象，而非打破它們。

col: go to the movies｜去看電影
tip: movie偏美式，英式常用film；the movies可指電影院。

senses.en: To accept that something is true or someone is truthful.
To think that something is likely or correct.
To have confidence or faith in someone or something.

ex.en: I believe you, but your story sounds quite unusual.
ex.zh: 我相信你，但你講的事情聽起來很不尋常。

ex.en: Some educators believe that practical experience is just as valuable as academic knowledge in preparing students for employment.
ex.zh: 一些教育工作者認爲，在幫助學生爲就業做準備方面，實踐經驗與學術知識同樣重要。

tip: believe someone指相信其話；believe in someone指信任其能力。

senses.en: Connected railway vehicles that carry passengers or goods.
Teach or practise skills needed for an activity or job.

ex.en: We caught the last train home after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚飯後，我們趕上了回家的末班火車。

ex.en: Governments should train more healthcare workers to meet the needs of an ageing population.
ex.zh: 政府應培訓更多醫護人員，以滿足老齡化人口的需求。

col: train for a marathon｜爲馬拉松訓練
tip: 交通方式用by train；在某列火車上用on the train。

senses.en: Thin material used for writing, printing, or wrapping.
A publication containing news, usually printed on large sheets.
An academic article or a written examination.

ex.en: She wrapped the small gift in bright yellow paper.
ex.zh: 她用鮮黃色的紙把小禮物包了起來。

ex.en: The university encourages students to submit assignments electronically to reduce paper consumption across its departments.
ex.zh: 這所大學鼓勵學生以電子形式提交作業，以減少各院系的紙張消耗。

tip: 紙不可數，用a piece of paper；論文、報紙可數。

senses.en: introduces a condition for something to happen
introduces an indirect question about whether something is true

ex.en: If it rains, we can play indoors instead.
ex.zh: 如果下雨，我們可以改在室內玩。

ex.en: If cities invest in safe cycling routes, more residents may choose bicycles for their daily journeys.
ex.zh: 如果城市投資建設安全的自行車道，更多居民可能會選擇騎車進行日常出行。

tip: 談未來條件時，if從句通常用一般現在時。

senses.en: Large in size, amount, or degree.
Important or likely to have a strong effect.

ex.en: We need a big bag for all these towels.
ex.zh: 我們需要一個大袋子來裝所有這些毛巾。

ex.en: Public transport can make a big difference to air quality in rapidly growing cities.
ex.zh: 公共交通能顯著改善快速發展城市的空氣質量。

tip: big較口語；正式寫作可按語境用large或major。

senses.en: The body part at the arm's end, with fingers and thumb.
Help with doing a task.
To give something to someone by holding it out.

ex.en: She held the warm cup in her left hand.
ex.zh: 她用左手握着溫熱的杯子。

ex.en: Practical workshops allow students to develop skills by making objects with their own hands.
ex.zh: 實踐工作坊讓學生通過親手製作物品來培養技能。

col: give someone a hand｜幫某人一把
hand in an assignment｜提交作業
tip: give someone a hand表示幫忙；by hand表示手工。

senses.en: having the colour of lemons or ripe bananas
the colour of lemons or ripe bananas
to become yellow or make something yellow

ex.en: She picked a yellow umbrella for the rainy walk.
ex.zh: 她挑了一把黃色雨傘，準備在雨中散步。

ex.en: Yellow leaves may indicate that urban trees are suffering from water shortages or poor soil conditions.
ex.zh: 黃葉可能表明城市樹木正受到缺水或土壤條件不佳的影響。

tip: 可作動詞表示變黃；不要用它描述人的種族。

senses.en: Having a lot of money or valuable possessions.
Containing a large amount or variety of something valuable.
Containing plenty of fat, cream, sugar, or strong flavour.

ex.en: Their rich uncle owns a large house by the sea.
ex.zh: 他們富有的叔叔在海邊擁有一棟大房子。

ex.en: Rich countries can support global development by investing in clean energy projects in poorer regions.
ex.zh: 富裕國家可以通過投資貧困地區的清潔能源項目來支持全球發展。

col: rich in nutrients｜富含營養成分
rich cultural heritage｜豐富的文化遺產
tip: “富含……”用 rich in，不用 rich of。

senses.en: To have information or understanding about something
To be familiar with a person, place, or thing

ex.en: Do you know how to fix this bicycle?
ex.zh: 你知道怎麼修這輛自行車嗎？

ex.en: Consumers need to know how their personal information is collected before they can make informed choices online.
ex.zh: 消費者需要了解個人信息的收集方式，才能在網上作出知情選擇。

tip: 過去式knew，過去分詞known；通常不用進行時。

senses.zh: 堂兄弟姐妹；表兄弟姐妹
senses.en: A child of your aunt or uncle

ex.en: My cousin taught me to ride a bicycle yesterday.
ex.zh: 我的表姐昨天教我騎自行車。

ex.en: Children who regularly spend time with their cousins may develop strong family bonds beyond their immediate household.
ex.zh: 經常與堂表兄弟姐妹相處的孩子，可能與小家庭之外的親人建立深厚感情。

col: a distant cousin｜遠房堂親或表親
a younger cousin｜年幼的堂表親
tip: 不區分堂表、性別或長幼；需要時另加說明。

senses.en: The eleventh month of the year.

ex.en: We are moving into our new flat in November.
ex.zh: 我們將在十一月搬進新公寓。

ex.en: The university plans to launch its new scholarship programme in November, allowing more international students to apply.
ex.zh: 該大學計劃在十一月推出新的獎學金項目，讓更多國際學生能夠申請。

tip: 月份首字母大寫；月份前用in，具體日期前用on。

senses.en: A small place serving drinks and light meals.

ex.en: We shared a sandwich at the cafe beside the station.
ex.zh: 我們在車站旁的小餐館分着喫了一份三明治。

ex.en: A neighbourhood cafe can strengthen community ties by providing a welcoming space for residents to meet.
ex.zh: 社區咖啡館可以爲居民提供友好的聚會空間，從而加強社區聯繫。

tip: 也寫作café；通常提供飲料和簡餐。

senses.en: to have your home somewhere, lead a life, or remain alive
broadcast or performed as it happens, rather than recorded
alive rather than dead

ex.en: My grandparents live in a quiet village near the coast.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母住在海邊一個安靜的村莊裏。

ex.en: People who live near public transport often depend less on private cars for their daily journeys.
ex.zh: 住在公共交通設施附近的人日常出行往往較少依賴私家車。

col: live a healthy life｜過健康的生活
tip: 動詞讀/lɪv/；形容詞及表示現場直播的副詞讀/laɪv/。

senses.en: the female person or animal receiving an action
belonging to or connected with a female person or animal

ex.en: I called her after lunch to arrange a walk.
ex.zh: 午飯後我給她打了電話，約好一起散步。

ex.en: When a student requests additional support, teachers should help her access appropriate learning resources.
ex.zh: 當一名女學生請求額外支持時，教師應幫助她獲取合適的學習資源。

tip: her可作賓語或接名詞表所屬；hers獨立使用。

senses.en: moving or acting fast, without much delay
taking only a short time

ex.en: Her quick reaction stopped the glass from falling.
ex.zh: 她反應敏捷，及時接住了差點掉落的玻璃杯。

ex.en: A quick response to reports of water pollution can prevent serious damage to nearby ecosystems.
ex.zh: 對水污染報告作出迅速回應，可以防止附近生態系統遭受嚴重破壞。

tip: 正式表達中用副詞quickly修飾動作。

senses.en: the eighth month of the year

ex.en: We usually visit our grandparents by the sea in August.
ex.zh: 我們通常八月去看望住在海邊的祖父母。

ex.en: Tourist destinations often experience increased demand in August, putting pressure on local transport and accommodation.
ex.zh: 旅遊目的地的需求往往在八月增加，給當地交通和住宿帶來壓力。

tip: 月份首字母大寫；月份前用in，具體日期前用on。

senses.en: a country in central Europe

ex.en: My cousin moved to Germany to study engineering.
ex.zh: 我的表親搬到德國去學工程了。

ex.en: Germany has invested in renewable energy as part of its efforts to reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 德國投資可再生能源，以減少對化石燃料的依賴。

tip: Germany是國名；German可指德語、德國人或德國的。

senses.en: A container made from flexible material, used for carrying things.
To put something into a bag.

ex.en: She put the apples in a reusable bag.
ex.zh: 她把蘋果放進了一個可重複使用的袋子裏。

ex.en: Charging customers for plastic bags can encourage shoppers to adopt more environmentally responsible habits.
ex.zh: 向顧客收取塑料袋費用，可以鼓勵購物者養成更環保的習慣。

col: a reusable bag｜可重複使用的袋子
tip: a bag of後接所裝物品，如a bag of rice。

senses.en: a sport involving hitting a ball over a net with rackets

ex.en: We play tennis at the park on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我們每逢週日都在公園打網球。

ex.en: Providing affordable tennis lessons can encourage young people to exercise regularly and develop greater physical coordination.
ex.zh: 提供價格實惠的網球課程，可以鼓勵年輕人經常鍛鍊並提高身體協調能力。

tip: 說 play tennis，不加冠詞；球拍用 racket。

senses.en: A small furry animal often kept as a pet.
An animal belonging to the same family as lions.

ex.en: Our cat sleeps in a sunny spot by the window.
ex.zh: 我們家的貓睡在窗邊陽光照得到的地方。

ex.en: Keeping pet cats indoors can help protect native birds, particularly in areas with vulnerable wildlife populations.
ex.zh: 將寵物貓養在室內有助於保護本地鳥類，尤其是在野生動物種羣脆弱的地區。

tip: big cats指獅、虎等大型貓科動物。

senses.en: A particular area, position, or location.
To put something in a particular position.
A space available for someone to sit, study, or participate.

ex.en: This shady spot is a lovely place for a picnic.
ex.zh: 這處陰涼的地方很適合野餐。

ex.en: Urban planners should place public facilities near residential areas to make essential services accessible to everyone.
ex.zh: 城市規劃者應將公共設施設在住宅區附近，讓所有人都能方便地獲得基本服務。

col: a university place｜大學錄取名額
tip: take place表示發生或舉行，不用被動語態。

senses.en: a one-piece garment with a top and a skirt
to put clothes on yourself or someone else
clothing of a particular type or worn for a particular occasion

ex.en: She wore a blue dress to her sister's party.
ex.zh: 她穿了一條藍色連衣裙去參加姐姐的聚會。

ex.en: Some employers require formal dress, while others allow staff to wear casual clothing at work.
ex.zh: 有些僱主要求穿正裝，而另一些則允許員工上班時穿便裝。

tip: a dress指連衣裙；get dressed指穿好衣服。

senses.en: A small rodent with a pointed nose and long thin tail.
A handheld device for moving a pointer on a computer screen.

ex.en: A tiny mouse slipped behind the cupboard before breakfast.
ex.zh: 早飯前，一隻小老鼠溜到了櫥櫃後面。

ex.en: Using a mouse for long periods may cause wrist discomfort, so office workers should take regular breaks.
ex.zh: 長時間使用鼠標可能引起手腕不適，因此辦公室職員應定時休息。

tip: 老鼠的複數是mice；鼠標的複數可用mice或mouses。

senses.en: a road vehicle with wheels, usually carrying a few people
one of the separate sections of a train

ex.en: Our car is parked under the tree outside.
ex.zh: 我們的汽車停在外面的樹下。

ex.en: Reducing private car use could improve urban air quality and make streets safer for pedestrians.
ex.zh: 減少私家車使用可以改善城市空氣質量，讓街道對行人更安全。

tip: by car不加冠詞；in a car需要冠詞。

senses.en: the meal you eat at the start of the day

ex.en: I usually have breakfast before taking the bus.
ex.zh: 我通常喫完早餐再去坐公交車。

ex.en: Schools that provide a healthy breakfast may help students concentrate better during morning lessons.
ex.zh: 提供健康早餐的學校可能有助於學生在上午的課堂上更加專注。

col: a balanced breakfast｜營養均衡的早餐
tip: 泛指喫早餐用have breakfast，不加冠詞。

senses.en: To write or say the letters of a word in order.
A period during which a particular condition or activity continues.
Words or magic believed to have special powers.

ex.en: Could you spell your surname slowly for me, please?
ex.zh: 請你把姓氏慢慢拼給我聽，好嗎？

ex.en: A prolonged spell of dry weather can reduce crop yields and increase pressure on local water supplies.
ex.zh: 持續的乾旱天氣會降低農作物產量，並加大當地供水壓力。

col: a spell of illness｜一段患病期
tip: 過去式及過去分詞英式可用spelt或spelled。

senses.en: to stop and hold something moving, or capture someone
to reach a bus, train, or plane in time
to become ill with an infectious disease

ex.en: Can you catch the ball with just one hand?
ex.zh: 你能只用一隻手接住球嗎？

ex.en: More frequent bus services would help commuters catch connecting trains without relying on private cars.
ex.zh: 增加公交班次將幫助通勤者趕上接續列車，而不必依賴私家車。

col: catch someone's attention｜吸引某人的注意
tip: 過去式和過去分詞均爲caught；感冒用catch a cold。

senses.en: feel deep affection for someone or enjoy something very much
a strong feeling of affection or great enjoyment

ex.en: I love walking by the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡晚飯後沿着河邊散步。

ex.en: Schools can develop children's love of reading by providing diverse books and regular library visits.
ex.zh: 學校可以通過提供多樣化的圖書和安排定期參觀圖書館，培養孩子對閱讀的熱愛。

col: love of learning｜對學習的熱愛
tip: love doing和love to do均可表示喜歡做某事。

senses.en: the number after three and before five

ex.en: We put four chairs around the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我們在廚房桌子周圍放了四把椅子。

ex.en: The research team compared four methods of reducing household energy use during the winter months.
ex.zh: 研究團隊比較了四種減少冬季家庭能源消耗的方法。

tip: four是基數詞；表示順序“第四”用fourth。

senses.en: To let someone see something or demonstrate how something works.
To provide information or evidence that something is true.
A performance, programme, or public display intended for an audience.

ex.en: Please show me how to fold this paper bird.
ex.zh: 請教我怎麼折這隻紙鳥。

ex.en: Recent studies show that access to green spaces can improve mental wellbeing in urban populations.
ex.zh: 近期研究表明，能夠使用綠地有助於改善城市居民的心理健康。

col: show someone how to｜教某人如何
tip: 過去式showed，過去分詞通常用shown。

senses.en: In a higher position than something else.
Greater than a particular amount, level, or standard.
In a higher place or earlier in a piece of writing.

ex.en: A small wooden shelf hangs above the kitchen sink.
ex.zh: 廚房水槽上方掛着一個小木架。

ex.en: Temperatures above the seasonal average can increase water demand and put pressure on urban supplies.
ex.zh: 高於當季平均水平的氣溫會增加用水需求，給城市供水帶來壓力。

tip: above 表示位置更高，不一定正上方，也不表示接觸。

senses.en: someone who has just started learning or doing something

ex.en: This swimming class is perfect for a complete beginner.
ex.zh: 這堂游泳課非常適合完全沒有基礎的初學者。

ex.en: Courses designed for beginners should provide clear guidance and regular opportunities to practise new skills.
ex.zh: 爲初學者設計的課程應提供清晰的指導，以及定期練習新技能的機會。

col: a complete beginner｜零基礎初學者
tip: beginner是可數名詞，單數前通常要有限定詞。

senses.en: Produce tears because of sadness, pain, or strong emotion.
Call out loudly because of strong emotion or urgent need.
A loud sound expressing emotion or attracting attention.

ex.en: The baby began to cry when her toy fell.
ex.zh: 玩具掉了，寶寶就哭了起來。

ex.en: Young children may cry when separated from their parents, so schools should provide a welcoming environment.
ex.zh: 幼兒與父母分開時可能會哭，因此學校應營造親切友好的環境。

col: have a good cry｜痛哭一場
tip: 過去式cried；現在分詞crying；表示喊叫常用cry out。

senses.en: to obtain something by paying money for it
to believe an explanation or accept an idea

senses.zh: 買到的東西；合算的購買
senses.en: something bought, especially something offering good value

ex.en: I need to buy some bread before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我需要在喫早飯前買些麪包。

ex.en: Consumers can reduce packaging waste when they buy fresh produce from local markets.
ex.zh: 消費者在當地市場購買新鮮農產品時，可以減少包裝廢棄物。

tip: 過去式和過去分詞均爲bought；不要寫成buyed。

senses.en: Having little length, height, or duration.
Not having as much of something as is needed.
Before reaching a target, or with a sudden stop.

ex.en: We took a short walk before dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚晚飯前，我們散了一小會兒步。

ex.en: Short training courses can help unemployed adults acquire practical skills without committing to several years of study.
ex.zh: 短期培訓課程能幫助失業成年人獲得實用技能，而不必投入數年時間學習。

tip: short of表示缺少；shortly通常意爲“不久”。

senses.en: a group of words expressing a complete statement, question, or command
a punishment officially given by a court
to officially give someone a punishment in court

ex.en: Our teacher asked us to write one sentence about autumn.
ex.zh: 老師讓我們寫一個關於秋天的句子。

ex.en: Learning to vary sentence length can help students express complex ideas more clearly in academic essays.
ex.zh: 學會變化句子長度，可以幫助學生在學術文章中更清晰地表達複雜觀點。

col: sentence someone to｜判處某人……刑罰
tip: 判某人某種刑罰用sentence sb to sth。

senses.en: to have clothes, jewellery, or accessories on your body
to damage or become damaged through repeated use
damage caused by regular use over time

ex.en: I always wear thick socks when the floor feels cold.
ex.zh: 地板涼的時候，我總會穿上厚襪子。

ex.en: Encouraging employees to wear protective equipment can significantly reduce the risk of injuries in industrial workplaces.
ex.zh: 鼓勵員工穿戴防護裝備，可以顯著降低工業場所的工傷風險。

tip: wear強調穿戴狀態，put on強調動作；過去式wore。

senses.en: a period of twenty-four hours
the part of each day when there is natural light
a particular period in the past or present

ex.en: We spent the whole day building sandcastles on the beach.
ex.zh: 我們一整天都在海灘上堆沙堡。

ex.en: Shorter working days may improve employee wellbeing while allowing parents to spend more time with their children.
ex.zh: 縮短每日工作時間可能改善員工的身心狀態，同時讓家長有更多時間陪伴孩子。

tip: every day意爲每天；everyday是形容詞，意爲日常的。

senses.en: Schoolwork that students are asked to complete outside lessons.
Research or preparation done before making a decision.

ex.en: I finished my homework before dinner and went outside.
ex.zh: 我在晚飯前做完了作業，然後出門了。

ex.en: Schools should limit homework so that children have enough time for exercise and family activities.
ex.zh: 學校應限制家庭作業量，讓孩子有足夠的時間鍛鍊和參加家庭活動。

col: do your homework｜做好事前準備
tip: 不可數名詞；一項作業用a piece of homework。

senses.en: Of higher quality or more suitable than something else.
In a more effective or satisfactory way.
Less ill than before.

ex.en: This backpack is better than my old one.
ex.zh: 這個揹包比我原來的那個好。

ex.en: Better public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in growing cities.
ex.zh: 更好的公共交通能緩解交通擁堵，並改善發展中城市的就業可達性。

tip: 是good和well的比較級，不說more better。

senses.en: towards and then inside something
used to show the result of a change
interested in or enthusiastic about something

ex.en: The kitten jumped into the basket beside my chair.
ex.zh: 小貓跳進了我椅子旁的籃子裏。

ex.en: Converting unused offices into affordable housing could help cities address shortages without expanding into surrounding countryside.
ex.zh: 將閒置辦公室改造成經濟適用住房，可幫助城市緩解住房短缺，而不必向周邊鄉村擴張。

col: walk into a room｜走進房間
look into a problem｜調查問題
tip: into強調進入的過程；in通常表示在裏面。

senses.en: a two-wheeled vehicle moved by pushing pedals
to travel by bicycle

ex.en: I locked my bicycle outside the small bakery.
ex.zh: 我把自行車鎖在那家小麪包店外面。

ex.en: Travelling by bicycle can reduce urban air pollution while providing residents with regular physical exercise.
ex.zh: 騎自行車出行既能減少城市空氣污染，也能讓居民經常鍛鍊身體。

tip: by bicycle不加冠詞；ride a bicycle要加冠詞。

senses.en: To go to see a person or place.
An occasion when someone goes to see someone or somewhere.

ex.en: We visited our neighbours and shared some homemade soup.
ex.zh: 我們去拜訪鄰居，和他們分享了一些自制的湯。

ex.en: Students who visit science museums can connect classroom theories with practical examples from everyday life.
ex.zh: 參觀科學博物館的學生能夠把課堂理論與日常生活中的實際例子聯繫起來。

col: pay a visit to｜拜訪；參觀
a guided visit｜有導遊陪同的參觀
tip: 動詞visit後直接接賓語；名詞用a visit to。

senses.en: Every person in a group, or all people.

ex.en: Everyone brought a dish to share at the picnic.
ex.zh: 每個人都帶了一道菜，在野餐時一起分享。

ex.en: Public libraries should ensure that everyone can access reliable information, regardless of income or educational background.
ex.zh: 公共圖書館應確保每個人都能獲取可靠信息，不論收入或教育背景如何。

tip: everyone接單數謂語；every one強調逐個。

senses.en: Not correct, accurate, or suitable.
Not morally acceptable or fair.
In an incorrect way, or with an unsuccessful result.

ex.en: I took the wrong bus and ended up near the airport.
ex.zh: 我坐錯了公交車，結果到了機場附近。

ex.en: It is wrong to deny children educational opportunities simply because their families cannot afford school fees.
ex.zh: 僅僅因爲家庭付不起學費就剝奪兒童受教育的機會，是不正當的。

col: something is wrong with｜……出了問題
tip: go wrong表示出問題；wrong的詞首w不發音。

senses.en: a situation that causes difficulty and needs a solution
a question requiring thought or calculation to answer

ex.en: There's a problem with the kitchen tap: it keeps dripping.
ex.zh: 廚房的水龍頭有問題：它一直滴水。

ex.en: Traffic congestion is a growing problem that requires investment in reliable public transport rather than additional roads.
ex.zh: 交通擁堵是日益嚴重的問題，需要投資建設可靠的公共交通，而不是增建道路。

tip: ……有問題用a problem with；問題的解決辦法用to。

senses.en: a parent's brother or an aunt's husband

ex.en: My uncle taught me how to mend a bicycle.
ex.zh: 我叔叔教過我怎樣修自行車。

ex.en: An uncle or aunt can provide valuable emotional support when parents are busy with work commitments.
ex.zh: 父母忙於工作時，叔伯姑姨等親屬可以提供寶貴的情感支持。

col: uncle and aunt｜叔伯姑姨等親屬
tip: uncle不區分父母哪一方，也不區分長幼。

senses.en: An object shaped to open or close a particular lock.
Something essential for understanding or achieving something.
Extremely important to a situation or its outcome.

ex.en: I left my house key in my coat pocket.
ex.zh: 我把家門鑰匙放在外套口袋裏了。

ex.en: Access to reliable information is key to helping consumers make informed decisions about their health.
ex.zh: 獲取可靠信息是幫助消費者就自身健康作出明智決定的關鍵。

col: the key to success｜成功的關鍵
play a key role｜發揮關鍵作用
tip: the key to中to是介詞，後接名詞或動名詞。

senses.en: Use your voice to say words or communicate with someone.
Be able to communicate in a particular language.
Address an audience about a subject.

ex.en: Could I speak to you after the lesson?
ex.zh: 下課後我能和你談談嗎？

ex.en: Students who speak more than one language may find it easier to communicate across cultural boundaries.
ex.zh: 會說多種語言的學生可能更容易進行跨文化交流。

tip: 過去式spoke，過去分詞spoken；語言前不用介詞。

senses.en: to look at written words and understand their meaning
to say written words aloud
to understand information shown by something

ex.en: I read a few pages before bed every night.
ex.zh: 我每天晚上睡前都會讀幾頁書。

ex.en: Children who read regularly often develop stronger language skills and a broader understanding of the world.
ex.zh: 經常閱讀的兒童通常能培養更強的語言能力，對世界也有更廣泛的瞭解。

tip: 原形讀/riːd/；過去式及過去分詞讀/red/。
